verdict.rationale: Obsidian Sync is an official first-party add-on for privately syncing notes across devices (obsidian-docs-32). End-to-end encryption is the default, and the docs state that not even the Obsidian team can access your notes (obsidian-docs-21, obsidian-docs-35, obsidian-docs-9). Version history (obsidian-docs-28) and a headless client (obsidian-docs-10) add depth. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Sync's end-to-end encryption and cross-device reliability.
